National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. 
 
 Bid Compliance Checklist 
 
 
 ComplianCe CheCklist 
 
 Tender RFP-132003007 · Sewerage Drainage 
 
 CM/31 March 31, 2026 
 
 
 # Requirement Status Evidence (under separate cover) 
 
 1 Quality management certification (ISO Complied Certificate ORG-1001 
 9001:2015) 
 
 2 Environmental management (ISO Complied Certificate ORG-1002 
 14001:2015) 
 
 3 Occupational health & safety (ISO Complied Certificate ORG-1003 
 
 45001:2018) 
 4 Minimum average turnover requirement Complied Audited statements, FY 2019-2025
 
 (Rs. 180 Cr) 
 
 5 Similar-works experience (5 yrs minimum) Complied Completion certificates annexed
 separately 
 
 6 Key technical staff (10 minimum) Complied 486 personnel on rolls; CVs under
 separate cover 
 
 7 Plant & machinery deployment Complied 210 owned assets; deployment schedule
 
 annexed 
 
 8 Earnest money deposit Complied EMD-0031 
 
 Figures are evidenced by the referenced documents and are not restated here.
 
 
 
 Authorised Signatory, National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd.
